claims.text: The proposed intervention is to use machine-learning potentials trained on ab initio molecular-dynamics data.
Machine-learning potentials can improve simulation accuracy for multicomponent high-entropy materials at high temperature.
Machine-learning potentials can improve simulation efficiency for multicomponent high-entropy materials at high temperature.
The intervention will determine the solid-to-fluid transition temperature more accurately than existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will determine fusion enthalpy more accurately than existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will determine fusion entropy more accurately than existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will determine the volume change at the transition more accurately than existing experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will determine dense-fluid heat capacity more accurately than existing experimental and computational methods.
The performance of the intervention is limited by the quality of its training data.
The performance of the intervention is limited by system complexity.
